_comment: Plugin manifest (authored by the plugin author). 'version' is the plugin semver (release-only); install-plugin reads 'setup'.
name: browserctl-asc
description: Browser-control extension plugin for App Store Connect: one site skill (browserctl.asc.skill.md) that operates ASC and developer.apple.com from the developer's perspective - API-first over the ASC REST API where possible, browserctl for the browser-only flows (App Privacy questionnaire, EU DSA trader status, agreements, IAP setup, API-key creation) - with field-tested flows, dialog technique, and pitfalls for iOS and macOS apps. Extends the base browserctl plugin (required in the same project); first of the browserctl-<site> extension-plugin family.

notes: Requires the base browserctl plugin attached to the same project - this plugin ships only the ASC site skill on top of it.
The signed-in Apple session lives in a browserctl profile: log in once headed (2FA needs the owner); the session persists in the profile and nowhere else.

resources.name: asc_browser_profile
resources.prompt: browserctl profile that holds (or will hold) the signed-in Apple/ASC session
